rows.en: The MSP includes a range of sectors/AORs as you can see on the slide, including:​
rows.ne: स्लाइडमा देखिएअनुसार MSP मा विभिन्न क्षेत्र/AORs समावेश छन्, जसमा निम्न पर्छन्:
rows.bt: As shown on the slide, various sectors/AORs are included in the MSP, including the following:
rows.note: AORs is absent from the supplied glossary. Proposed addition: area of responsibility; preserve the source acronym and plural form.

rows.en: Health, Education, Protection, (CP, GBV, MA), Nutrition, Camp Coordination and Camp Management (CCCM), Shelter & Settlements, WASH and Food Security and Livelihoods​
rows.ne: स्वास्थ्य, शिक्षा, संरक्षण, (CP, GBV, MA), पोषण, शिविर समन्वय तथा शिविर व्यवस्थापन (CCCM), आश्रय तथा बस्ती, खानेपानी, सरसफाइ तथा स्वच्छता (WASH) र खाद्य सुरक्षा तथा जीविकोपार्जन
rows.bt: Health, education, protection, (CP, GBV, MA), nutrition, camp coordination and camp management (CCCM), shelter and settlements, drinking water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) and food security and livelihoods
rows.note: The frozen WASH form narrows water to drinking water; the source acronyms and sector-list relationships are retained. bt-divergence: The frozen WASH form specifies drinking water rather than the sector's broader water component. All listed sectors and acronyms are otherwise retained. The frozen form is retained.

rows.en: For ease of reference, icons are provided alongside each MSP activity to indicate sectors, clusters or AoRs that are typically well placed to deliver or contribute to it.
rows.ne: सन्दर्भ हेर्न सजिलो होस् भनेर प्रत्येक MSP गतिविधि सँगै चिह्नहरू राखिएका छन्। यी चिह्नहरूले उक्त गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्न वा त्यसमा योगदान दिन सामान्यतया उपयुक्त स्थितिमा रहेका क्षेत्र, क्लस्टर वा AoRs जनाउँछन्।
rows.bt: Symbols have been placed alongside each MSP activity to make reference easy. These symbols indicate the sectors, clusters or AoRs generally in a suitable position to conduct or contribute to that activity.
rows.note: AoRs is absent from the supplied glossary. Proposed addition: area of responsibility; preserve the source acronym and plural form.

rows.bt: Shelter, CCCM and drinking water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH): are generally in a suitable position to contribute to this activity.

rows.en: Child Protection (represented by the green icon) and/or Education (represented by the red icon) actors will provide group activities for children. ​

rows.bt: Actors associated with child protection (indicated by the green symbol) and/or education (indicated by the red symbol) will conduct group activities for children.

rows.en: Whereas Shelter, CCCM and WASH can contribute to the activity. ​
rows.ne: जबकि आश्रय, CCCM र खानेपानी, सरसफाइ तथा स्वच्छता (WASH) ले यस क्रियाकलापमा योगदान दिन सक्छन्।
rows.bt: Whereas shelter, CCCM and drinking water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) can contribute to this activity.
rows.note: The frozen WASH form narrows water to drinking water; the contrast and possibility of contributing are retained. bt-divergence: The frozen WASH form narrows water to drinking water. The contrast, actors and possibility of contributing are otherwise preserved. The frozen form is retained.

rows.en: What does contribute or support the activity mean?​
rows.ne: उक्त गतिविधिमा योगदान दिनु वा सहयोग गर्नुको अर्थ के हो?
rows.bt: What does contributing to or supporting that activity mean?

rows.en: For example, in this instance, Shelter and/or CCCM actors might facilitate this activity by providing the space for it to take place.
rows.ne: उदाहरणका लागि, यस अवस्थामा आश्रय क्षेत्रका सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू र/वा CCCM सम्बद्ध पक्षले उक्त गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्न स्थान उपलब्ध गराएर सहजीकरण गर्न सक्छन्।
rows.bt: For example, in this situation, actors associated with the shelter sector and/or an actor associated with CCCM can facilitate the conduct of that activity by providing a space.

rows.en: In addition, Shelter, CCCM and WASH may contribute to activity 3.6 by notifying the community about when and where these activities are happening. ​
rows.ne: यसका अतिरिक्त, आश्रय, CCCM र खानेपानी, सरसफाइ तथा स्वच्छता (WASH) ले यी क्रियाकलापहरू कहिले र कहाँ भइरहेका छन् भन्नेबारे समुदायलाई जानकारी दिएर क्रियाकलाप 3.6 मा योगदान दिन सक्छन्।
rows.bt: In addition, shelter, CCCM and drinking water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) can contribute to activity 3.6 by informing the community about when and where these activities are taking place.
rows.note: The frozen WASH form narrows water to drinking water; the possible contribution to activity 3.6 and notification of both time and place are retained. bt-divergence: The frozen WASH form narrows water to drinking water. The possible contribution to activity 3.6 through notifying the community of both time and place is otherwise preserved. The frozen form is retained.

rows.en: It is important to note that the icons are not intended to be prescriptive, but a guide to who typically does what.
rows.ne: यी चिह्नहरू कसले के गर्नैपर्छ भनेर तोक्नका लागि नभई सामान्यतया कसले के गर्छ भन्ने विषयमा मार्गदर्शन दिनका लागि हुन् भन्ने कुरा ध्यानमा राख्नु महत्त्वपूर्ण छ।
rows.bt: It is important to keep in mind that these symbols are to provide guidance on who generally does what, not to specify who must do what.

rows.en: MHPSS MSP Activities
rows.ne: MHPSS MSP गतिविधिहरू
rows.bt: MHPSS MSP activities

rows.en: Now let’s look again at the list of MHPSS activities in the MSP but now with its associated icons.
rows.ne: अब MSP मा रहेका MHPSS गतिविधिहरूको सूची फेरि हेरौँ, तर यस पटक तिनसँग सम्बन्धित चिह्नहरू सहित।
rows.bt: Now let us look again at the list of MHPSS activities in the MSP, but this time with their associated symbols.

rows.en: As you can see, all sectors are tagged in Section 1 as their contribution is fundamental in coordination efforts and also to promote a coordinated approach to the assessment of an emergency and to the prioritization of the needs.
rows.ne: तपाईंहरूले देख्नुभएझैँ, खण्ड 1 मा सबै क्षेत्रलाई चिन्हित गरिएको छ, किनकि समन्वयका प्रयासहरूमा र आपत्कालीन अवस्थाको लेखाजोखा तथा आवश्यकताहरूको प्राथमिकीकरणका लागि समन्वित दृष्टिकोण प्रवर्द्धन गर्न तिनको योगदान आधारभूत हुन्छ।
rows.bt: As you have seen, all sectors are marked in Section 1, because their contribution is fundamental to coordination efforts and to promoting a coordinated approach to assessing the emergency situation and prioritizing needs.
rows.note: Coordination is a recurring technical term absent from the supplied glossary; proposed wording: [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence]. The back-translation makes coordination efforts another object of promoting a coordinated approach. The source distinguishes contributing to coordination efforts from promoting a coordinated approach to emergency assessment and needs prioritization.

rows.en: Section 2 does not have any icons next to it because these activities relate to internal organizational processes and don’t require inter-sectoral coordination
rows.ne: खण्ड 2 को छेउमा कुनै चिह्नहरू छैनन्, किनकि यी गतिविधिहरू संस्थाका आन्तरिक प्रक्रियासँग सम्बन्धित छन् र यिनका लागि अन्तरक्षेत्रीय समन्वय आवश्यक पर्दैन।
rows.bt: There are no marks beside Section 2, because these activities relate to the organization's internal processes and do not require intersectoral coordination.
rows.note: Inter-sectoral coordination is absent from the supplied glossary; proposed wording: [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence].

rows.en: These activities are here to guide organizations internal work and systems as they are crucial for the planning and implementation of a safe and effective MHPSS response.
rows.ne: यी गतिविधिहरू संस्थाहरूका आन्तरिक कार्य र प्रणालीलाई दिशा दिन यहाँ समावेश गरिएका छन्, किनकि सुरक्षित र प्रभावकारी MHPSS प्रतिकार्यको योजना तथा कार्यान्वयनका लागि यी अत्यन्त महत्त्वपूर्ण छन्।
rows.bt: These activities are included here to guide organizations' internal work and systems, because they are extremely important for planning and implementing a safe and effective MHPSS response.

rows.en: Organizations must have sound systems for program design, for coordination, for M&E, for caring for staff & volunteers and for building the MHPSS competencies of staff & volunteers.
rows.ne: संस्थाहरूमा कार्यक्रमको रूपरेखा तयार गर्न, समन्वय गर्न, अनुगमन तथा मूल्याङ्कन (M&E) गर्न, कर्मचारी र स्वयंसेवकको हेरचाह गर्न तथा कर्मचारी र स्वयंसेवकको MHPSS सम्बन्धी सक्षमता विकास गर्न सुदृढ प्रणालीहरू हुनैपर्छ।
